# What's on Weibo

> > What's on Weibo is a leading platform analyzing Chinese social media trends, viral controversies, and digital culture through Sina Weibo and other platforms.

Founded by Manya Koetse, What's on Weibo provides real-time insights into trending topics, social controversies, and cultural phenomena across China's digital landscape. The site covers everything from social justice debates and celebrity scandals to consumer trends and generational shifts, offering English-language analysis of what's capturing attention on Chinese social media.

## Key Topics

- Weibo trending topics and viral controversies
- Chinese social media landscape (Sina Weibo, Toutiao)
- Social justice and labor rights debates
- Digital surveillance and privacy concerns
- Chinese parenting and generational issues
- Celebrity and influencer scandals
- Consumer culture and marketing campaigns
- Cross-cultural misunderstandings (China-Japan, China-West)
- Education and academic achievement
- Gender relations and leftover women discourse
- Public outcry and online activism
- Regional trends (Beijing, Shanghai, Hangzhou, Nanjing, Guangdong)
- Cultural identity and nationalism
- Worker surveillance and GPS tracking
- Child safety and welfare
